intro.text: Footwear worn by Yumi and her attendants, who slip on their getuk when they step down from their wagon.
Heavy clogs of wood that the Torish wear to lift their feet some six inches clear of the hot ground.

description.text: Getuk come in several designs, among them a fashionable high-heeled style, and take practice to walk in. They slip on and off easily and are normally left outside the home. Their clatter on stone warns of anyone approaching, and a person bowing may rest a knee on one to kneel.
They block much of the heat but not all of it, so they help less in hotter places; out in the searing barrens the ground can even make the wood catch fire.
